dishes.name: Skagenssalat
dishes.desc: Prawns in a mayonnaise and dill dressing, piled on rye bread or toast. Named after Skagen at the northern tip of Jutland.

dishes.name: Stegt rødspætte
dishes.desc: Breaded plaice fried in butter and served with remoulade and lemon. A standard fish lunch on the North Jutland coast.

dishes.name: Marinated herring
dishes.desc: Herring pickled in vinegar or curry sauce and eaten on rye bread. A fixture of the Danish lunch table and the North Jutland harbours.

dishes.name: Frikadeller
dishes.desc: Pan-fried pork meatballs served with potatoes and red cabbage. The everyday Danish home dish, found in traditional lunch restaurants.

dishes.name: Skagen fish plate
dishes.desc: A plate of fried and smoked fish from the Skagen fleet, served with rye bread and remoulade in harbour restaurants.
